summary: Fixed three dashboard and worker bugs (dragging the picked video, sign-out on a network error, a release download error) and wrote four video verdicts.
why: All checks were green; three open backlog bugs had a clear fix with a test. The data audit was skipped: its file is about 25 hours old because the 16 Nov run hadn't started yet (the 15 Nov audit had 0 errors).

findings.title: Data audit late, not failed
findings.detail: metrics/data-audit.json is from 15 Nov 15:44 UTC; the 16 Nov scheduled run had not started by 16:35 UTC. The last audit had 0 errors and 0 warnings.

findings.title: Costco and US-debt Shorts beat the median
findings.detail: 868 and 453 views in 48 hours against a Shorts median of 83; 63.6% and 70.8% viewed against 47%.

findings.title: Netflix Short loops but loses a third on the second line
findings.detail: 237.7% viewed, but 26% stayed to watch (median 31.2%) and a 33-point fall at 5.9 s on "And it still kept $11B."

changes.title: Dragging the picked video now sticks
changes.detail: A reorder keeps the owner's pick only while that video is still first of its format; before, the pick pulled it back to the top.

changes.title: Sign out always reaches the login page
changes.detail: A network error during sign-out no longer leaves an unhandled error and no redirect.

changes.title: Local release downloads report the real error
changes.detail: A re-downloaded video is found instead of failing with 'gh CLI was not found'.
